helpers.statement: ∀ r : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < r → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal δ ≤ r
helpers.proof:
intro r hr
by_cases htop : r = ⊤
· exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, by simp [htop]⟩
· exact ⟨r.toReal, ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt hr) htop, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le⟩
